item.title: 'Seattle News Weekly': Recap of the Super Bowl parade
item.description: On this week's episode of the Seattle News Weekly podcast, FOX 13's Hana Kim and Austin Lane discussed the excitement surrounding the Super Bowl and the parade in Seattle.

item.title: Jamaican man pleads guilty in $550K Vancouver, WA lottery scam
item.description: A Jamaican man pleaded guilty in Tacoma to a lottery scam that stole more than $550,000 from a 73-year-old Washington woman.

item.title: Filtered sunshine on Valentine's Day in Seattle
item.description: Tonight, we'll stay mainly cloudy with showers gradually falling apart. We’ll be watching for the chance of a convergence zone, particularly across the North Sound early Saturday.

item.title: Seattle homeless encampment sweep brings hope, but worries remain
item.description: Crews have cleared a homeless encampment near local businesses in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, leaving owners relieved, but also counting the cost of months of disruption, theft, and vandalism.

item.title: Seattle Amazon workers rally to cut company ties with ICE
item.description: Amazon workers and advocacy groups rallied in Seattle on Friday, urging the company to cut ties with ICE and other federal agencies.

item.title: Seattle weather: Mainly dry and cool this weekend
item.description: It will be mainly dry this weekend with high temperatures a few degrees below average. Valentine's Day evening will be chilly, but dry.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks player calls 8-year-old fan who lost signed ball at parade
item.description: A young Seahawks fan got a football signed by several players during Wednesday's parade. But, one wrong bounce and it's been lost. Now, Seahawks players and Washingtonians are making it right.

item.title: Prosecutors request $3M bail for suspect in Ballard police officer shooting
item.description: King County prosecutors are requesting that a 62-year-old man accused of shooting at police in Ballard have his bail set at $3 million.

item.title: Crowds gather in Bellevue, WA in support of Iranian protests
item.description: Residents gathered in Bellevue on Saturday for a demonstration amid ongoing protests in Iran. Police in the area advise drivers to seek alternative routes due to traffic disruptions.

item.title: Chilly, wintry weather ahead for Seattle
item.description: As we head into the work week, temperatures stay on the cool side with highs in the mid 40s and overnight lows dipping into the upper 20s to low 30s.
